title: Double asteroid solar eclipse caught on camera | Space photo of the day for Nov. 24, 2026
caption:
The Hera probe just captured a rare solar eclipse 121 million miles away. One asteroid is casting a shadow onto its partner, helping us understand how to protect Earth from future impacts.
